instructions.name: deposit_single_token_routed
docs: Same plan and accounts as `deposit_single_token_planned`, executed as one
coffer-pool `swap_route_join_v1` CPI; floors are checked after the CPI on every slot.

types.name: AllocationPlan
docs: Signed gross input allocation bound to a state commitment and freshness limits.

fields.name: allocations
docs: Gross input spent on each ordered swap; the input slot is the amount
reserved for joining. Sum must equal amount_in exactly.

fields.name: expected_state
docs: State commitment checked before spending the input budget.

fields.name: quoted_at
docs: Plan creation time in Unix seconds; future timestamps are rejected.

fields.name: valid_until_slot
docs: Last valid execution slot, inclusive.

types.name: AssetConfig
docs: Admin-controlled per-token configuration.

fields.name: mint
docs: Token mint; `Pubkey::default()` past `token_count`.

fields.name: token_program
docs: SPL Token or Token-2022 program ID for this token's vault/transfers.

fields.name: normalized_weight
docs: Normalised weight in basis points (active slots sum to 10_000).

fields.name: max_selloff_pct
docs: Max sell volume per window, `PERCENT_SCALE` share of the window-open vb snapshot; `0` = off.

fields.name: max_selloff_period_length
docs: Sliding window length in seconds.

fields.name: variable_fee_threshold_pct
docs: Window fill at which the surge fee starts, `PERCENT_SCALE` units.

fields.name: variable_fee_slope_low_pct
docs: Surge fee at the threshold.

fields.name: variable_fee_slope_high_pct
docs: Surge fee at full window fill; `<= PERCENT_SCALE`.

fields.name: is_active
docs: Input-side kill switch: `false` reverts swaps selling this token; buys still work.

fields.name: variable_fee_slope_mid_pct
docs: Surge fee at the kink; `slope_low <= slope_mid <= slope_high`.

fields.name: variable_fee_kink_pct
docs: Kink position in whole percent of window fill, between threshold and 100; `0` = no kink.

types.name: AssetDynamics
docs: Raw reserves, accrued protocol fees and rolling selloff-window state for one mint.

fields.name: virtual_balance
docs: Virtual balance (raw units) used by pricing; decoupled from `actual_balance`.

fields.name: actual_balance
docs: LP-owned part of the vault, raw units; the fee buckets share the vault.

fields.name: protocol_fees_owed
docs: Accrued protocol fees (raw units) awaiting `collect_protocol_fees`.

fields.name: previous_selloff
docs: Amount sold in the previous window.

fields.name: current_selloff
docs: Amount sold in the current window.

fields.name: window_start_timestamp
docs: Unix time the current window started.

fields.name: selloff_vb_snapshot
docs: `virtual_balance` at window open; the selloff cap is computed from it. `0` = uninitialised.

types.name: CofferPool
docs: Per-pool state of a weighted AMM with virtual liquidity. `LEN` = 2304 bytes.
Storage layout: DO NOT REORDER, fields are read by raw offset. Append-only: a new field
goes directly before `reserved_v61`, which shrinks by the same amount.
Per slot `vault.amount >= actual_balance + protocol_fees_owed + creator_fees_owed +
surge_fees_owed`; only `actual_balance` prices trades.
Account traits are hand-written so `try_deserialize` rejects `data_len != LEN`.

fields.name: config
docs: `CofferPoolConfig` this pool belongs to; also a PDA seed.

fields.name: bump
docs: Pool PDA bump.

fields.name: token_count
docs: Active token count in `[MIN_TOKENS, MAX_TOKENS]`; slots beyond it are zeroed.

fields.name: pool_id
docs: Salt in the PDA seeds; unique per config.

fields.name: swap_fee_rate
docs: Swap fee in hundredths of a bps (`SWAP_FEE_PRECISION` = 1_000_000).

fields.name: protocol_fee_rate
docs: Protocol share of each swap fee in bps (`PROTOCOL_FEE_PRECISION` = 10_000).

fields.name: created_at
docs: Creation Unix time; informational.

fields.name: pool_enabled
docs: Master switch: `false` reverts swaps and add/remove liquidity. Protocol admin only.

fields.name: swaps_enabled
docs: `false` blocks swaps; liquidity ops still work. Pool admin or protocol admin.

fields.name: pool_admin
docs: Per-pool admin.

fields.name: pending_pool_admin
docs: Pending successor of `pool_admin` in a 2-step transfer. @98

fields.name: range_manager
docs: Key allowed to call `range_manager_update`; `Pubkey::default()` = none.

fields.name: range_manager_enabled
docs: `false` reverts every `range_manager_update`.

fields.name: range_manager_max_vb_change_pct
docs: Max per-update change of a token's `virtual_balance`, `PERCENT_SCALE` units of its value.

fields.name: range_manager_max_weight_change_pct
docs: Max per-update change of a token's `normalized_weight`, `PERCENT_SCALE` units.

fields.name: range_manager_min_update_interval_secs
docs: Minimum seconds between manager updates.

fields.name: range_manager_last_updated
docs: Last range-manager update time in Unix seconds.

fields.name: tokens
docs: Per-token state; slot `i` is the i-th token.

fields.name: lookup_table
docs: Per-pool Address Lookup Table, frozen; `Pubkey::default()` = not initialised.

fields.name: _deprecated_banned_extensions
docs: Legacy extension-policy bitmap, bytes 1651..1659; still read by legacy checks, preserve.

fields.name: range_manager_max_concentration_factor_bps
docs: Max `virtual_balance / actual_balance` the range manager may leave, bps. `0` disables.

fields.name: range_manager_min_concentration_factor_bps
docs: Min `virtual_balance / actual_balance` the range manager may leave, bps. `0` disables.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Frozen legacy padding, bytes 1667..1683; `reserved[..4]` holds the `V5M1` marker.

fields.name: layout_version
docs: Appended-block version (`LAYOUT_VERSION_V61`); the account size is the real marker. @1683

fields.name: token_decimals
docs: Per-slot mint decimals pinned at init / migration. Transfers require the live mint to
match, so a mint re-created at the same address with other decimals is refused. @1684

fields.name: creator_fee_bps
docs: Pool admin's share of the fee left after the protocol cut, bps; never moves the price. @1694

fields.name: creator_fees_owed
docs: Accrued creator share per slot (raw units); not part of `actual_balance`. @1696

fields.name: surge_fees_owed
docs: LP holders' share of surge fees per slot (raw units). Outside the curve (never traded or
priced) but part of LP NAV: joins buy in and burns pay out pro rata. @1776

fields.name: deposit_fee_bps
docs: Deposit fee on minted LP: `lp_minted = lp_gross - ceil(lp_gross * bps / 10_000)`, rounded
against the depositor; the withheld share accrues to existing LPs. @1856

fields.name: withdraw_fee_bps
docs: Withdraw fee per token: `payout_i = gross_i - ceil(gross_i * bps / 10_000)`. The fee stays
in its reserve or surge bucket for the remaining LPs. @1858

fields.name: liquidity_fee_lock
docs: Bit `LIQUIDITY_FEE_LOCK_FROZEN` (0x01): `set_liquidity_fees` rejected for ever. @1860

fields.name: range_manager_locked
docs: One-way flag set by `lock_range_manager`: no range manager, ever. @1861

fields.name: pool_admin_delay_secs
docs: Seconds a D-class pool-admin action waits before execution; `0` = direct path allowed. @1862

fields.name: pool_admin_epoch
docs: Incremented on every pool-admin change; all pending slots are cleared with it. @1866

fields.name: pending_pool_admin_eta
docs: `eta` of the in-flight pool-admin transfer; `0` = none. @1870

fields.name: hook_program
docs: Hook program CPI'd around swaps and liquidity ops; default key = none. Immutable. @2054

fields.name: hook_flags
docs: `coffer_hook_interface::flags` bitmap; bits 8..15 are 0. Immutable. @2086

fields.name: hook_disabled
docs: Protocol-admin emergency switch: `1` = no callback runs, no hook slice in the tail. @2088

fields.name: hook_fee_min
docs: Lower clamp of a `before-swap` fee override, hundredths of bps. Immutable. @2089

fields.name: hook_fee_max
docs: Upper clamp of a fee override (`<= MAX_SWAP_FEE_RATE`). Immutable. @2093

fields.name: hook_max_cu
docs: Compute-unit ceiling per callback, CPI base cost included. Immutable. @2097

fields.name: hook_accounts_len
docs: Account count of the hook slice `[hook_program, hook_caller, extras..]`. Immutable. @2101

fields.name: safety_flags
docs: Bit 0: ever seeded. Bits 1..=10: protocol token restrictions, bit 11: swaps, bit 12: range
manager; pool-admin actions never clear them. @2102

fields.name: range_manager_weight_anchors
docs: Initial weights (bps); range-manager weight changes are bounded relative to them. @2104

fields.name: lp_transfer_fee_protocol_share_bps
docs: Protocol share of collected LP transfer fees, bps; the rest is burned. @2124

fields.name: lp_transfer_fees_owed_protocol
docs: LP collected for the protocol, held in `ATA(pool, lp_mint)` with the pending burn. @2126

fields.name: lp_transfer_fees_pending_burn
docs: Burn part of collected LP still in the fee account, vesting linearly. @2134

fields.name: lp_transfer_fee_burn_last_ts
docs: Start of the stream's current segment: the last collect that burned something. @2142

fields.name: lp_transfer_fee_burn_end_ts
docs: Unix time at which `lp_transfer_fees_pending_burn` is fully burnable. @2160

fields.name: vault_bump_cache
docs: Per-slot canonical vault (ATA) bump, encoded `bump + 1`; `0` = not cached (bump 255 is
never cached: its `find` costs one attempt, same as `create`). Written only by this
program from `find_program_address`; a reader falls back to `find` on any mismatch. @2168

fields.name: reserved_v61
docs: Zeroed reserve; shrinks as fields are appended before it. @2178
